$comment: Advisories that are present in the dependency tree but not reachable in this application.
Every entry states why, and carries a review date so it cannot quietly become permanent.
An advisory not listed here fails the build, whatever its severity, if it is high or above.

allowed.title: Stack exhaustion when merging recursive object graphs
allowed.why: Reached only by Prisma's config loader, which merges prisma.config.ts — a file in this repository. The input is never attacker-controlled, and the loader runs at CLI and startup time rather than on a request path.
allowed.fix: Requires deepmerge-ts >= 8, a major bump that @prisma/config has not taken. Forcing it through an override would put an untested major inside Prisma's own config loading, which is a larger risk than the advisory.

allowed.title: Missing buffer bounds check in v3/v5/v6 when buf is provided
allowed.why: Pulsara uses exactly one function from firebase-admin, verifyIdToken. The Firestore and Cloud Storage clients that reach uuid are never constructed, and the advisory additionally requires the caller to pass a buf argument, which nothing here does.
allowed.fix: Requires uuid >= 11.1.1, two majors above what the Google Cloud libraries pin. firebase-admin v14 may carry it; upgrading the auth SDK across a major without a real Firebase project to verify against would be shipping an untested change to the sign-in path.
